reviews.title: Cute themes but way too many ads
reviews.text: This app has the cutest themes! When I first installed it there were so many to choose from. However, if you happen to be like me and choose one of the free themes, you might have realised that you need to watch an add to unlock the theme, then watch like 15 more ads to unlock the app icons which is ridiculous. I’ve used apps that only required to watch ONE ad for the whole theme. Also, It keeps overheating my phone for some reason? 🥲💔
